**The document doesn't report any HumanEval results**, so it can't answer this question.

The only code benchmark used is LiveCodeBench (p. 2, p. 13). HumanEval's source paper (Chen et al., 2021) is cited only for the unbiased pass@k estimator (p. 26), not as an evaluation benchmark.

The closest available data is Adapted Parallel-RL's LiveCodeBench accuracy on the 1.5B model. These are reported as accuracy (%), not explicitly as pass@1:

| 1.5B setting | Adapted Parallel-RL on LiveCodeBench | Single-Task RL |
|---|---|---|
| Full-parameter GRPO (Table 4, p. 7) | 22.5% | 21.6% |
| LoRA GRPO (Table 6, p. 24) | 17.3% | 17.8% |
| Full-parameter PPO (Table 6, p. 24) | 19.5% | 20.3% |

The paper's pass@k analysis (pp. 26–27, Figure 7) covers only Naive Parallel-RL, not Adapted Parallel-RL. It is also shown only as curves, with no numeric pass@1 values.
